Developer documentation

Get from a checkout to a running .pac program.

Practical, reproducible instructions for the currently supported bootstrap environment.

Install the bootstrap and run a program

This repository currently ships a Python-hosted development toolchain; there is no official binary installer or release package.

From a source checkout

python3 --version
./bin/peacock version
./bin/peacock check examples/hello.pac
./bin/peacock run examples/hello.pac

// The smallest PEACOCK program.

Python 3.11+

Requirements

The bootstrap and tests use the Python standard library; package building uses the declared setuptools build backend.

.pac / .pkb / .pkm

Canonical files

Source files use .pac. The compiler emits verified .pkb bytecode images; models use .pkm.

fmt · lint · doc · init

Developer CLI tools

Format source with peacock fmt, run static/capability lints with peacock lint, scaffold with peacock init, and generate docs with peacock doc.

Prepared

Editor support

A TextMate grammar and VS Code metadata exist; no published extension or language server is available.

CLI referenceLanguage specification

Complete developer workflow

Check, format, lint, document, test and build use the same unified CLI.

Daily commands

Selectable source — use your browser's copy command. · SHA-256: 1d345ac3717ebdd2

./bin/peacock init my_project
./bin/peacock fmt path/to/app.pac --check
./bin/peacock lint path/to/app.pac
./bin/peacock doc --stdlib
./bin/peacock check path/to/app.pac --semantic-shadow
./bin/peacock test
./bin/peacock build path/to/app.pac -o app.pkb
